labctl.notes: HOST-NATIVE (native from day one): MAME 0.289 palmiii runs on the host, no QEMU/QMP, no guest OS, no exec channel. Frames drawshm->shm, pen through ctlsock's new absolute-field bind (MAME_CTL_ABS=1), audio FIFO. Launcher stations/mame-native/x11-runtime.sh; reset=relaunch restores the golden savestate in /data/vms/streamhost/stations/palmos/sta.

render.stationsManifestPrelude: # palmos (slot 207) — Palm III, host-native MAME palmiii, Palm OS 3.3 (French); palmos wave 2026-09-20.

listing.reason: Dark launch: palmos wave 2026-09-20 landed the MAME palmiii driver, a new absolute-ioport-field pointer route (mame-ctlsock-abs-fields.patch), and a byte-verified Palm OS 3.3 French ROM, but the golden scene is still the Palm OS Welcome/digitizer-setup flow, not the Applications Launcher (no byte-exact English ROM was found inside this wave's budget; see docs/lab/PALMOS-WAVE.md). Promote once a golden stream reaches the Launcher scene and re-checks the pointer proof against it.

museum.blurb: The pocket organizer that made the stylus practical — instant-on PIM apps, Graffiti handwriting and a software ecosystem built for a few seconds of attention at a time.
museum.notes: Host-native station: MAME 0.289's palmiii driver (src/mame/palm/palm.cpp, Palm III, MC68328 "DragonBall") runs on the host -- drawshm frames, ctlsock pen input, no QEMU and no guest OS. ROM: palmos33-fr-iii.rom (2 097 152 B), byte-exact match (SHA-1 c7c90df814d4f97958194e0bc28c595e967a4529) for the palmos33-fr-iii.rom BIOS option the driver defines; sourced as Palm-III-3.3-fr.rom from palmdb.net's palm-roms-complete collection. No byte-exact English Palm OS 3.x ROM for this driver was found inside the wave's time budget -- palmdb's own Palm-III-3.3-en.rom is a different (1 343 488 B) dump that does not match any BIOS option this MAME driver defines -- so French is the honest first-release locale; see docs/lab/PALMOS-WAVE.md. Pointer: Palm's pen is IPT_LIGHTGUN_X/Y, a true ABSOLUTE analog ioport field (PORT_MINMAX(0,0xa0)), not a relative mouse like every other MAME station -- mame-ctlsock-abs-fields.patch (new this wave) makes MOVEA write the field directly, scaled from the published 160x220 surface into the field's own range, no accumulator and no cursor readback.

reset.mouse: OPEN — see docs/lab/PALMOS-WAVE.md for the measured five-target accuracy on this wave's rig
reset.keyboard: PARTIAL — the driver's seven hardware buttons (Power, Up, Down, and four app-launch buttons) are bound over ctlsock and reachable from a physical keyboard (D/Y/H/F/G/J/K); on-screen-keyboard labels for them are an OPEN spa-stream item, see docs/lab/PALMOS-WAVE.md
reset.fixture: Palm III, MAME 0.289 palmiii driver, Palm OS 3.3 (French) BIOS, host-native (drawshm) on the published 160x220 surface (the driver's own visarea, no letterbox). See docs/lab/PALMOS-WAVE.md for the golden scene and its proof.
